title: Wyvern Maritime — on‑prem triage & next steps
content:
Meeting: deep tech sync with Wyvern Maritime ops (2026-02-25)
Attendees: Wyvern: N. Carver (CTO), L. Gomez (SRE), T. Huang (Network). Redwood: Ava M (SE), Marco L (infra), Sofia P (security).

High‑level ask
- Air‑gapped, on‑site inference for ETA/route‑optimization assistant used by vessel hubs. No outbound internet from inference cluster.
- Soft SLO: 95th pct < 120ms p99 for 64‑token responses during peak (expected bursts: 180 qps for 30s windows).
- Data residency: logs/metrics must remain in customer network; audit log copies to KMS only on admin request.

What we captured (requirements + notes)
- Hardware: Wyvern plans to provision 2 x A40 per rack, 4 racks initial (8 GPUs). They prefer DGX‑style server images but can mirror as pods.
- Network: strict egress block. Only a management jump host allowed to talk to Redwood control plane via dedicated private link during onboarding window.
- Storage: local NVMe cache + NFS for model artifacts (models will be preloaded via external HDD transfer).
- IAM/KMS: customer has HSM (Thales). Must integrate for key wrap/unwrap and not export unencrypted keys.
- Telemetry: limited metrics allowed out; agree on a small envelope: per‑pod token counts, latency histograms, partitioned by model id. No raw prompts or traces leaving network.

Technical gotchas / risks
- Air‑gap + HSM: onboarding flow needs manual steps. Automated model sync (rsync) will be disabled; we must provide a signed bundle and installation checklist.
- KV cache warmup: first‑time cold start for new models will spike GPU memory and latency; recommend prewarm job during non‑peak hours.
- Autoscaling: their infra team doesn’t want autoscale that calls external APIs. Need to offer an internal scaler (k8s HPA with internal metrics) or scheduled scaling.
- Fallbacks: No cloud fallback allowed per contract. Must handle degraded model variants locally (quantized 8bit) and ensure prompt guards to avoid hallucination regressions.

Proposed Redwood config (initial)
- Dedicated private control plane image v1.8.2 (manual install bundle).
- Serving runtime: quantized variant (q8f16) of route‑model for cost/latency tuning. KV cache: persistent NVMe-backed.
- Scheduler: k8s HPA using local token_rate metric; policy: scale-up threshold at 75% GPU util sustained 30s.
- Telemetry: ship aggregated (1m) metrics to s3 endpoint inside Wyvern network; periodic signed digest to Redwood control plane for billing reconciliation only when enabled.

Open questions for Wyvern (action items to clarify)
- L1: Confirm whether HSM provides PKCS#11 interface and which certs can be exported. (Owner: L. Gomez) — deadline 2026-03-06.
- L2: Approve list of telemetry metrics allowed outbound (Marco to send proposed CSV).
- L3: Expected QPS profile over 24h (they gave weekend traffic only) — we need full weekday profile to size prewarm.
- L4: Offline model update window — how often can we schedule signed bundle installs? (Wyvern to confirm weekly vs monthly).

Immediate next steps (Redwood owners)
- Marco: draft manual onboarding runbook for air‑gapped install, include step for HSM keywrap and verification script. Target: 2026-03-05.
- Ava: outline prewarm job script + recommended model quantization targets; run quick sim using 8 GPUs to validate 95th pct latency. Target: 2026-03-08.
- Sofia: prepare redacted telemetry schema + legal blurb for audit logs to ensure no PII leaves network. Target: 2026-03-04.
- Coordination call: schedule technical dry‑run 2026-03-11 with Wyvern infra team (30m).

Notes to self / conversational bits
- Keep fallback variants conservative — Wyvern cares about correctness over cost.
- Might need a special contract clause for manual model rollouts and emergency patches.
- Consider a stripped debugging agent that runs locally and accepts signed debug snapshots for root cause without shipping raw logs.

Appendix: quick checklist for air‑gapped onboarding
- Confirm VLAN + management jump host IPs.
- Prepare signed model bundle (sha256) and install script.
- HSM PKCS#11 test harness + sample keywrap test.
- Prewarm job cron + model cache validation.
- Local metrics sink endpoint + retention policy doc.

Origin: captured during sync + postcall notes. Will iterate once Wyvern answers open questions.
